critical_code_review_comments: POCreateForm.jsx line 278 productOption label uses productColorText(p, formData.supplier_id); when the selected supplier does not have a supplier_colors entry it renders only the internal color. Behaviour matches spec but relies on product master having up-to-date supplier_colors. Consider a fallback tooltip listing all known supplier versions to help buyer awareness.

RFQCreateModal.jsx line 52 productOptions uses productColorText(p) without supplier context (RFQ is multi-supplier). Currently prints just the internal color + FIRST supplier_colors entry via ProductColorChip default. Confirmed label shows 'Palembang Silk House: Navy 07' which is desired first-versi. Fine, but document behaviour: if a product has multiple supplier_colors, only the first is shown in the dropdown label.
